brief.headline: Move to 30-day credit to free ₹8.73 L working capital and close the ₹12.95 L/year price gap to our best supplier

priceAsk.summary: Step down to ₹66.48/KG for Dextrose, in line with our best-in-portfolio price
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG (current ₹70.80/KG) — a 6.5% reduction recovering ₹12.95 L annual excess
priceAsk.basis: We already pay ₹66.48/KG to Sayaji Industries Limited for the same material; market export value is ₹42.95/kg, so our ask sits well above commodity floor

paymentTermAsk.summary: Replace 100% advance payment with standard 30-day credit terms
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹8.73 L working capital freed; a further 15-day improvement would release another ₹4.36 L

brief.financialLeverage: Sukhjit is a ₹1458.95 Cr revenue company with a thin 2.3% net margin and 6.4% EBITDA margin, carrying 0.61x debt-to-equity. Their health score is D (39/100), signalling fragility. We are 0.07% of their revenue (₹1.06 Cr), so we have minimal individual clout. The thin margin means a hard price squeeze risks destabilising supply; our strongest lever is unwinding the punitive advance-payment terms — which cost them nothing but free our cash — and using credible alternates to create competition rather than unilateral pressure.

evidence.point: We overpay by 6.5% versus our best supplier for Dextrose
Sayaji Industries delivers the same material at a lower price
We pay 100% in advance, the worst terms in our portfolio
evidence.figure: current: Advance 100%(with tax)Against Proforma Invoice, areWorstTerms: true

evidence.point: Shifting to 30-day credit releases significant working capital
Sukhjit operates on a razor-thin net margin
We represent a negligible share of their business

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji; C (56/100) health, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity; B (63/100) health, ₹821.13 Cr revenue

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette — pharma-grade dextrose/excipients; premium, very reliable; ₹2898.05 Cr revenue

risks: At 0.07% of their revenue (₹1.06 Cr vs ₹1458.95 Cr) we lack solo leverage — bundle volume or commit tenure to gain attention
Their 2.3% net margin and D (39/100) health score mean aggressive price pressure could destabilise a fragile supplier and jeopardise continuity
Advance payment gives them free working capital; they may resist credit terms more than price concessions
No borrowing-cost data available, so we cannot quantify the value of faster payment to them as a trade
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to align your pricing to the ₹66.48/KG we pay our best supplier and move to 30-day terms — that closes a ₹12.95 L annual gap and frees ₹8.73 L of our working capital while keeping healthy volume with you.
